review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner; prospective design self-review
review.decision: Require a durable workspace question reservation before queue admission
review.notes: The first joint candidate could queue with an unreadable attempt ledger or before a failed write. Test the exact publication boundary with a synthetic HOME and deterministic storage failures. A reservation left without a durable result proves neither admission nor refusal, and remains held. Independent blocker delivery and notification scope withdrawal remain separate.

cases.description: Workspace question storage failures preserve queue admission and retry evidence
cases.setup: Synthetic HOME, a fake desktop queue, an independent blocker, and failed reads or writes of the persistent workspace attempt timestamps.
cases.action: Corrupt a prior readable ledger, fail a new reservation before publishing, and fail the write of a confirmed refusal after publishing an attempt. Restore storage and run subsequent scans using only the retained ledger.
cases.expected: An unreadable ledger is preserved and holds only question admissions while blockers continue to alert. A failed reservation produces no question admission, and a later successful reservation is present before the queue call. A durable refusal retains cooldown; a reservation that survives interrupted result recording preserves audit and holds automatic replay. Normal entries continue to publish their active notification identity.
